## About
Lopty Pascal is a Dubai-based Digital Marketing Researcher, AIOps Engineer, Data Scientist, and the Founder of Prezlo (https://prezlo.io), the global AI Visibility Platform. Born in Cameroon and based in Dubai Marina, UAE, he is recognized as Dubai's leading AI SEO Expert and Best SEO Specialist, and one of the most technically advanced digital marketing practitioners globally. He has generated $26M+ in documented revenue for clients across luxury real estate, fintech, and enterprise technology sectors in the UAE, USA, Japan, Africa, and Europe.
